ProjectGuide.overviewSubtitle: What this protocol is trying to demonstrate
ProjectGuide.overview: This demo shows the core lifecycle of an overcollateralized stablecoin protocol: users deposit WETH or WBTC as collateral, the protocol calculates the USD value through price feeds, users mint DSC against that collateral, and the Health Factor determines whether the position is safe, risky, or liquidatable.

stablecoin.title: Overcollateralized Stablecoin
stablecoin.description: Users deposit crypto assets such as WETH or WBTC as collateral, and mint DSC stablecoins against that collateral.

health.title: Health Factor Risk Control
health.description: Every position has a Health Factor. A higher value means the account is safer; a lower value means it may be liquidated.

liquidation.title: Liquidation Protection
liquidation.description: If a user's collateral value falls too much, the protocol allows liquidation to protect the system from bad debt.

ProjectGuide.howToSubtitle: Complete each action independently so the effect on your position is clear.

deposit.title: Deposit Collateral
deposit.description: Lock WETH or WBTC in DSCEngine. This action does not mint DSC.
deposit.guided: One guided action will request approval first, then deposit {token}. Your wallet will confirm both transactions.
deposit.permitExplanation: Permit requests an off-chain signature first, then submits one on-chain transaction. The signature does not cost gas.

mint.title: Mint DSC
mint.description: Mint stablecoin debt against collateral already deposited in DSCEngine.
mint.unsafe: Warning: this amount exceeds the estimated safe mint capacity. You may still submit it, but DSCEngine will revert if the resulting Health Factor is below the protocol minimum.
mint.backed: DSC is minted from your existing collateral capacity, not created without backing.

repay.title: Repay DSC
repay.description: Burn wallet DSC to reduce debt and improve your Health Factor.
repay.approval: Approve DSC before the engine can burn it.
repay.permitExplanation: Permit requests an off-chain signature first, then submits one on-chain transaction. The signature does not cost gas.

redeem.title: Redeem Collateral
redeem.description: Withdraw deposited collateral without repaying DSC in the same action.
redeem.unsafe: Redeeming this amount would make your position unsafe.
redeem.warning: Redeeming collateral reduces your safety margin while DSC debt remains.

Oracle.title: Local Mock Price Oracle
Oracle.description: Simulate WETH and WBTC price changes to see how collateral value, Health Factor, and liquidation risk respond.
Oracle.risk: When collateral prices drop, your collateral value decreases and your Health Factor may fall. If the Health Factor becomes too low, the position can be liquidated. Repeated price-drop clicks reduce both assets by 25% per step, down to a $1 demo floor.
Oracle.dropSuccess: Collateral prices stepped down. Click again to continue the decline.

Liquidation.title: Liquidation
Liquidation.description: Repay DSC debt for an unsafe account and receive collateral plus the protocol liquidation bonus.
Liquidation.estimateExplanation: The liquidator repays {debt} DSC for the target account and receives about {collateral} in total, including the 10% liquidation bonus.
Liquidation.step1: Account A deposits 10 WETH and mints 9000 DSC.
Liquidation.step2: Simulate a price drop until Account A is liquidatable.
Liquidation.step3: Switch to Account B, which has a safe position and enough DSC.
Liquidation.step4: Approve DSC, then liquidate Account A with 1000 DSC.
Liquidation.noticeConnect: Connect a liquidator wallet to check DSC balance, allowance, and liquidation readiness.
Liquidation.noticeAddress: Enter a valid EVM address to inspect the target position.
Liquidation.noticeRead: Unable to read liquidation data. Check the local chain and contract state, then refresh the target position.
Liquidation.noticeSelf: You cannot liquidate the same wallet that is currently connected. Switch to another wallet account as the liquidator.
Liquidation.noticeHealthy: Position is healthy and cannot be liquidated.
Liquidation.noticeDebt: Debt to cover exceeds target user's debt.
Liquidation.noticeBalance: Insufficient DSC balance to cover this debt.
Liquidation.noticeUnsafe: Your own position is unsafe. Please repay DSC or add collateral before liquidating others.
Liquidation.noticeApproval: Approval required. DSCEngine must be allowed to transfer the DSC used to cover the target debt.
Liquidation.noticeImprove: If liquidation fails because the health factor is not improved, increase the debt to cover.

HealthFactor.title: Health Factor
HealthFactor.description: Understand how DSCEngine calculates solvency and liquidation risk.
HealthFactor.readError: Failed to read health factor data. Check whether Anvil is running, contracts are deployed, and your wallet is connected to the local network.
HealthFactor.healthMetricDescription: A value above 1.00 means the position is above the liquidation threshold.
HealthFactor.collateralDescription: Total deposited collateral value calculated by DSCEngine.
HealthFactor.mintedDebtDescription: Total DSC minted by this wallet.
HealthFactor.modelIntro: Health Factor is the protocol's core solvency metric.
HealthFactor.modelDescription: It measures whether a user's liquidation-adjusted collateral value is sufficient to cover their minted DSC debt. A higher value means the account has more safety margin. Once the value falls below 1.0, the position becomes eligible for liquidation.
HealthFactor.thresholdExplanation: In this demo, the liquidation threshold is 50%, meaning only half of the collateral value is treated as safe borrowing capacity.
HealthFactor.quantityDescription: Amount of collateral token i deposited by the user.
HealthFactor.priceDescription: USD oracle price of collateral token i.
HealthFactor.debtDescription: Total DSC minted by the user and not yet repaid.
HealthFactor.valuationDescription: DSCEngine converts deposited WETH and WBTC into USD value using price feeds.
HealthFactor.riskAdjustmentDescription: The collateral value is multiplied by the liquidation threshold to obtain safe borrowing capacity.
HealthFactor.debtNormalizationDescription: The adjusted collateral value is divided by minted DSC debt to produce the final health factor.
HealthFactor.repayDescription: Burning part of your DSC debt reduces the denominator of the risk calculation.
HealthFactor.addCollateralDescription: Depositing more WETH or WBTC increases your collateral value.
HealthFactor.watchPricesDescription: If collateral prices fall, your health factor can drop even without new actions.
HealthFactor.footer: This panel reads risk data directly from DSCEngine. In this demo, a health factor below 1.0 means the account can be used in the liquidation flow.

states.liquidatableDescription: Your health factor is below the safe threshold and the position may be liquidated.
